stories.title: Met Office provisional figures put Wales on course for driest July since 1836
stories.summary: Wales is on course for its driest July in 190 years of records and its warmest July on record, according to provisional Met Office figures published on Friday. stories.title: Funded childcare for all Flintshire two-year-olds by March 2027
stories.summary: Every two-year-old in Flintshire is due to qualify for 12.5 hours a week of funded childcare by the end of March 2027, ending the county’s postcode system. stories.title: Nine recent water deaths prompt north Wales safety meeting
stories.summary: North Wales Police has brought emergency services and rescue organisations together after nine recent water-related deaths in the region. stories.summary: Parents battling to save their school from closure have said Flintshire County Council is scaremongering to justify its proposed £55m Catholic super-school.
